## Core Capabilities & Disciplines
1. **Web Experiences & Interactive Sites**: Bespoke websites, high-performance landing pages, custom web animations, Awwwards-grade motion, and conversion-focused UX architecture built with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
2. **UGC & Social Storytelling**: High-retention short-form 9:16 vertical video production, ethnic fashion and apparel showcases (sarees, lehengas, bridal blouses), and creator product hooks engineered for TikTok and Instagram Reels.
3. **Brand Worlds & Design Systems**: Distinctive visual identities, bespoke Indian neo-vernacular typography, editorial layouts, and cultural art direction.
4. **AI Creative Systems**: AI-augmented creative pipelines, generative media workflows, smart UI automations, and human-taste-driven AI orchestration.
